title: Ravel pack configuration override
description: The values a pack states for one owner's settings. This is a per-setting document and never a replacement configuration file: a setting it does not name keeps the owner's declared default and stays the player's to change.

owner.description: The package whose settings these are, matching the pack manifest entry that names this document.

values.description: Setting key to the value the pack states for it. Each value is validated against that setting's valueSchema in the owner's configuration declaration, which is a different document and so is not expressible here.
